decisions.why: All 85 captured products are labour-ward, birthing and neonatal-warming equipment sold under the Croyde brand — birth pools, birthing stools/beds/beanbags, gynaecological examination couches/chairs, infant feeding chairs, neonatal warming mattresses/cots/hot cots, baby weigh scales and maternity ward furniture. This is a maternity-equipment specialist's whole catalogue, not a mixed division needing a product-level split: every example checked is unambiguously either labour/birthing equipment (womens:mat) or neonatal warming/weighing/cots (neonatal:equip). Awarded on NHS Supply Chain's Maternity, Obstetrics, Gynaecology and Sexual Health Products framework (2019/S 214-525123, as "Croyde Medical Ltd").
